import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_N = 250005;
    static final int MAX_M = 1 << 17;
    static final int MAX_D = 18;

    static int P;

    static long mod_pow(long base, int exp) {
        long res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = (res * base) % P;
            base = (base * base) % P;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static int[] fact = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] inv_fact = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] popcnt = new int[MAX_N];
    static long[][] s_a = new long[MAX_D][MAX_M];
    static long[][] s_c = new long[MAX_D][MAX_M];
    static long[][] d_p = new long[MAX_D][MAX_M];
    static long[][] t = new long[MAX_D][MAX_M];
    static int[] mask = new int[20];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        int L = sc.nextInt();
        int K = sc.nextInt();
        P = sc.nextInt();
        
        fact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= L; ++i) {
            fact[i] = (int) ((long) fact[i - 1] * i % P);
            popcnt[i] = popcnt[i >> 1] + (i & 1);
        }
        
        long total = mod_pow(K, L);
        if ((L & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(total);
            return;
        }
        
        inv_fact[L] = (int) mod_pow(fact[L], P - 2);
        for (int i = L; i > 0; --i) {
            inv_fact[i - 1] = (int) ((long) inv_fact[i] * i % P);
        }
        
        int n = 0;
        for (int i = 1; (1 << i) <= L; ++i) {
            if ((L >> i & 1) == 1) mask[n++] = 1 << i;
        }
        
        int m = 1 << n;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            int sum = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if ((i >> j & 1) == 1) sum += mask[j];
            }
            s_a[popcnt[i]][i] = inv_fact[sum];
        }
        
        for (int t_idx = 0; t_idx <= n; ++t_idx) {
            long[] arr = s_a[t_idx];
            for (int len = m; len >= 2; len >>= 1) {
                for (int j = 0, step = len >> 1; j < m; j += len) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < step; ++k) {
                        arr[j + k + step] += arr[j + k];
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) arr[j] %= P;
        }
        
        for (int t_idx = 0; t_idx <= n; ++t_idx) {
            System.arraycopy(s_a[t_idx], 0, d_p[t_idx], 0, m);
        }
        
        int revK = 0, cnt = 0;
        for (int temp = K; temp != 0; temp >>= 1) {
            revK = (revK << 1) | (temp & 1);
            ++cnt;
        }
        --cnt;
        revK >>= 1;
        
        for (; cnt > 0; --cnt, revK >>= 1) {
            for (int t_idx = 0; t_idx <= n; ++t_idx) {
                Arrays.fill(t[t_idx], 0, m, 0);
            }
            
            for (int a = 0; a <= n; ++a) {
                for (int b = 0; a + b <= n; ++b) {
                    long[] f = t[a + b];
                    long[] g = d_p[a];
                    long[] h = d_p[b];
                    for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                        f[j] += g[j] * h[j];
                    }
                }
            }
            
            for (int t_idx = 0; t_idx <= n; ++t_idx) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                    d_p[t_idx][j] = t[t_idx][j] % P;
                }
            }
            
            if ((revK & 1) == 1) {
                for (int t_idx = 0; t_idx <= n; ++t_idx) {
                    Arrays.fill(t[t_idx], 0, m, 0);
                }
                
                for (int a = 0; a <= n; ++a) {
                    for (int b = 0; a + b <= n; ++b) {
                        long[] f = t[a + b];
                        long[] g = d_p[a];
                        long[] h = s_a[b];
                        for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                            f[j] += g[j] * h[j];
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                for (int t_idx = 0; t_idx <= n; ++t_idx) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                        d_p[t_idx][j] = t[t_idx][j] % P;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int t_idx = 0; t_idx <= n; ++t_idx) {
            System.arraycopy(d_p[t_idx], 0, s_c[t_idx], 0, m);
        }
        
        for (int t_idx = 0; t_idx <= n; ++t_idx) {
            long[] arr = s_c[t_idx];
            for (int len = 2; len <= m; len <<= 1) {
                for (int j = 0, step = len >> 1; j < m; j += len) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < step; ++k) {
                        arr[j + k + step] -= arr[j + k];
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                arr[j] = (arr[j] % P + P) % P;
            }
        }
        
        long ans = (total - s_c[n][(1 << n) - 1] * fact[L] % P + P) % P;
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
